vocabulary.enumerationOrder: kernel legalActions iterates Object.keys(FORGE_MOVE_DIRECTIONS).sort() = EAST, NORTH, SOUTH, WEST, and only if the cell is unblocked
vocabulary.legalActionInsertionOrder: MOVE, RESTORE, PROTECT, REINFORCE/REPAIR, BYPASS, BUILD, TRANSFER, COLLECT, ATTACK, RETREAT, WAIT; then the whole list is re-sorted by action key
vocabulary.hashOrderInteraction: every consumer that breaks ties by action identity sees MOVE keys in hash order, which is fixed across worlds because the key depends only on type, actor id ("actor"), null target and direction name
vocabulary.proof: sha256 key order EAST < SOUTH < WEST < NORTH holds for every world (actor id is always "actor"); every DEV row's lowest-identity MOVE is the first legal direction in that order

placement.positionsAtDecisionEqualSpawn: warm-up plays only WAIT and is truncated at any task change, which includes positions (warmup.js taskSignature)
